hover.$description: The hover step of a filled tone that has no surface ramp of its own (rule 21): the fill mixed toward the theme's text colour, which is lighter on dark and darker on light, the direction the ramp moves. 15% is about one step of the dark ramp, surface3 to hover-raised. Declared wherever a theme is set, so --carbon-text is the one that theme defines. On a mid-tone picked accent that step would take the ink under 4.5:1, and applyAccent sets the ramp's hover as --accent-hover-light or --accent-hover-dark, a step away from the ink instead (accentHovers in contrast.ts).
